description: Source code implementing TLS key derivation functions (KDF) and HKDF expand label, part of BoringSSL/OpenSSL cryptographic library.

methods.name: tls1_P_hash
methods.description: Computes the TLS P_hash function as specified in RFC 5246, section 5, using HMAC with the provided hash.

methods.name: CRYPTO_tls1_prf
methods.description: Implements the TLS PRF, supporting MD5/SHA1 and other hash functions, returning derived key material.

methods.name: CRYPTO_tls13_hkdf_expand_label
methods.description: Performs HKDF expand label operation as used in TLS 1.3, producing key material based on label and context.
